title: Inter-agent messaging (escalation, interview, learning doorbell)
description: Default-off, BETA, claude-only capability that adds live coordination between GSD sessions and agents on top of Claude Code's shipped inter-agent messaging (SendMessage + ListAgents + resume-from-transcript). It packages three thin conventions, no engine changes: (1) an escalation/query channel where a blocked executor asks its orchestrator a scoped checkpoint question mid-flight instead of guessing, and where an orchestrator can interview a blocked/idle/completed agent's reasoning read-only instead of parsing its transcript; (2) a learning doorbell that, after /gsd-extract-learnings writes to the durable learnings store, rings self-owned sibling GSD sessions to re-read the store now (a doorbell only, never the learning itself); (3) a read-only /gsd-sessions conductor view of your live sessions. The security posture (every inbound message is untrusted data, never a command) is Claude Code's shipped message framing plus the receiver's own judgment; this capability configures and relies on it, it does not reinvent it. Durable .planning state and the learnings store remain the single source of truth (messaging is a doorbell, not a database). On any non-Claude runtime, below the version floor, or when disabled, behaviour is byte-identical to today (executors finish-and-report, learnings are read at plan-phase start only).

messaging.enabled.description: Master toggle. Default-off + BETA: escalation, interview, and the doorbell are inert unless this is true. When false, behaviour is exactly as today.

messaging.escalation.enabled.description: When true, executors dispatched by GSD orchestrators receive the escalation brief template (references/escalation-query-channel.md): on a genuine gray-area decision they may send a scoped query to their injected orchestrator address instead of guessing, and resume on the reply. Query/answer only, never mid-commit steering (the determinism firewall). Requires messaging.enabled.

messaging.doorbell.enabled.description: When true, /gsd-extract-learnings appends a ringer step: after writing the learning to the durable store, the (interactive) session rings self-owned sibling GSD sessions to re-read the store now. The message is a doorbell only; the learning itself is never sent. Requires messaging.enabled.

messaging.doorbell.sibling_filter.description: Glob matched against ListAgents session names to select which self-owned sessions receive the doorbell. Bounds the blast radius so the ringer never messages unrelated peers. Only same-user interactive sessions are ever considered.

messaging.min_claude_code_version.description: Minimum Claude Code version required to activate any messaging feature (stable session resume + cross-session messaging). Fails closed to no-op on any runtime reporting an older or unknown version. Platform additionally gated to macOS/Linux.

messaging.afk.enabled.description: When true, an autonomous orchestrator (e.g. gsd-autonomous) resolves an executor's delegated checkpoint using the AFK decider protocol (templates/afk-decider.md): classify against the scoped policy, decide within bounds or escalate to a human, and write an audit record either way. Because Claude Code has no platform sender allowlist, accountability is the audit log, not identity gating; keep the decider on the strong main/spawner axis. Requires messaging.enabled.

messaging.afk.policy_path.description: Path (relative to the project root) of the scoped decision policy the autonomous decider classifies against. Copy capabilities/messaging/policy/afk-decision-policy.example.json here and tune. Unmatched decision classes escalate to a human by default.

messaging.afk.audit_log_path.description: Path (relative to the project root) of the append-only AFK decision audit log. Every unattended decision - auto or escalated - is recorded here via scripts/afk-decision-log.cjs. Review with `afk-decision-log.cjs verify`.
